# PDF.js vendored runtime

- Upstream project: https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js
- npm package: `pdfjs-dist@6.4.299`
- Registry tarball: https://registry.npmjs.org/pdfjs-dist/-/pdfjs-dist-6.4.299.tgz

- Upstream license: Apache-2.0; complete upstream `LICENSE` is included beside these runtime files.
- Selected files only: `pdf.min.js` and `pdf.worker.min.js`; no default PDF.js viewer, fonts, maps, sample documents, or runtime network/CDN dependencies are included.
- Source PDF stays under the user's mutable game directory and is not part of the viewer assets or family package.
